label: Byzantine Icon
description: Flat gold-ground painting with inverse perspective and stylized figures; suited to sacred and symbolic narratives.
rendering: Byzantine icon painting: flat, frontal, stylized figures with elongated proportions, solemn timeless expressions, inverse perspective and symbolic rather than naturalistic space.
palette: Burnished gold-leaf sky, deep reds, ultramarine, ochres and earth greens.
lighting: No cast shadows; inner light shown through layered highlights and gold glow.
materials: Egg tempera and gold-leaf texture within the scene.
composition: Hieratic, balanced staging; the key subject largest and central; stylized rocks, buildings and trees.
negatives: Never show a wooden panel, panel edges, frame, border, wall or the icon as a physical object. Avoid photorealism and modern illustration. The gold sky and stylized landscape fill the image edge-to-edge.
